name: Badge
description:
A soft pill that labels state or category. Tone carries meaning (R3.3): status tones only
for status, accent for brand or selection, neutral for everything else.
signature: ({ tone, size, marker, icon, className, children, ...rest }: BadgeProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon instead of a marker. Pass the icon without a size.

props.name: marker
props.description: Leading marker. `dot` is the common case ("● Online").

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: tone
props.description: The semantic tone. Use danger and warning for consequences and states.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
